intro: Most honeymoons in India happen in the wedding season, from about November to February, which lines up well with the best months on the coast. A beach honeymoon works best where there are quiet beaches, a range of good stays and enough to do on days when you want more than the sand: a dive, a backwater cruise, a fort at sunset.
This guide compares the best beach honeymoon destinations in India. For the full range of honeymoon trips, including hills and heritage, see our honeymoon packages.
quickAnswer: The best beach honeymoon destinations in India are the Andaman Islands (Havelock and Neil) for white sand, snorkelling and sunsets; Lakshadweep for quiet lagoons; south Goa's Palolem, Agonda and Patnem; Kerala, combining Varkala, Kovalam or Poovar with the backwaters; Gokarna; and Pondicherry. The best time is November to March, which matches the wedding season. Allow five to seven nights for the islands.
takeaways: The Andamans are India's most popular beach honeymoon, with Havelock and Neil the main islands.
Lakshadweep is the most secluded option but needs permits and early planning.
South Goa is easier to reach and has quiet bays and romantic stays.
Kerala pairs a beach with a houseboat night on the backwaters.
November to March is the best season on most of the coast.

items.name: Andaman Islands
body: Radhanagar's sunsets, snorkelling at Elephant Beach, a try dive, and quiet evenings on Neil Island make the Andamans the classic Indian beach honeymoon. Split your stay between Havelock and Neil.

items.name: Lakshadweep
body: Bangaram and Agatti offer lagoon-side stays with very few other visitors. All visitors need an entry permit, usually arranged with a package.

items.name: South Goa
body: Palolem, Agonda and Patnem have quiet bays, boutique stays and good restaurants, with Old Goa and the Portuguese houses of the interior for a change of scene.

items.name: Kerala: Varkala, Kovalam, Poovar and Marari
body: Pair a cliff-top stay at Varkala, a resort at Kovalam or Poovar, or a quiet homestay at Marari with a night on a houseboat and an Ayurveda treatment.

items.name: Gokarna
body: Coves reached on foot, sunsets at Kudle and a laid-back scene, for couples who prefer simple stays to resorts.

items.name: Pondicherry
body: French Quarter walks, cafes, Paradise Beach and Auroville, easy to combine with a Kerala or Tamil Nadu trip.

sections.heading: Planning tips
list: Book the islands early for December and January; ferries and good stays sell out.
Balance travel days: avoid changing hotels every night.
Keep one day free of plans on longer trips.
Tell hotels it is your honeymoon; many offer small extras.
Consider travel insurance, especially for the islands, where weather can disrupt transfers.

safety: Swim only at beaches with lifeguards, inside the flagged zone, and never when a red flag is up or during the monsoon.
Follow crocodile warnings in the Andamans, and avoid creeks and mangroves.
Use licensed operators for diving and water sports.
Avoid the monsoon on the coast; the sea is rough and transfers are disrupted.
packing: Modest clothes for temples and churches

faqs.q: Which is the best beach honeymoon destination in India?
faqs.a: The Andaman Islands, for their beaches, snorkelling and sunsets. Lakshadweep is quieter; south Goa and Kerala are easier to reach.

faqs.q: How many days are enough for an Andaman honeymoon?
faqs.a: Five to seven nights, split between Havelock and Neil with a night in Sri Vijaya Puram.

faqs.q: Is Goa good for a honeymoon?
faqs.a: Yes, especially south Goa's quiet beaches such as Palolem, Agonda and Patnem.

faqs.q: What is the best time for a beach honeymoon in India?
Which beach honeymoon destinations are affordable?
faqs.a: Gokarna, Pondicherry, Varkala and the Konkan coast are more affordable than the islands.
